subject: rt-int-tr
title: RT.INT.TR.------TRS.
description: Diagram in NYM-19, on the page where Braxton argues that 'the post-Ayler movement, by benefit of its perceived relationship with western and/or American alternative functionalism, would solidify its composite identity as a thrust that corresponded to the new dictates of the sixties.' (C)RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) is crossed with TRS (transition). CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis) → RT-INT-TR; INDIV-DY (individual dynamics) → RT-INT-TR. LG-DISA (logical dissolution) → TRS; TRS → POST (postulation) → AFTD (affinity tendencies). ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism) → POST in parallel. IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) → JR-DYM (journalism dynamics) → LK-IMP (linkage implications). AFTD → LK-IMP. Structural argument: reality initiative traits are constituted by both culture information basis and individual dynamics — meaning the post-Ayler musicians' reality-initiative is fed by both culture-wide informational ground *and* personal individual dynamics. Transition is fed by logical dissolution (the breakdown of received logic) and produces postulation, which is over-fed by accelerated functionalism. Postulation produces affinity tendencies, which converge with journalism-dynamics (fed by infra-structure-dynamics) at linkage implications. The diagram thus stages the diagnostic Braxton names in NYM-19: the post-Ayler movement's reality-initiative-traits crossed with transition produces postulation as the productive node, but linkage implications — the connection to broader cultural significance — only forms when affinity tendencies converge with the journalism-dynamics chain. Journalism dynamics is the structural mechanism by which the music gets *recognized*, and recognition only happens at the linkage-implications convergence.
